options.label: Mode
options.description: melee: battles between alien races with their own ships, weapons and special abilities. classic: the original rock field.

options.label: Scene
options.description: A named set of the options below (see --list-presets); options you set yourself still win.

options.label: Randomize
options.description: auto: every option you or the scene leave unset is drawn from the seed at launch (planet size and gravity, boundary, matchups, palette, glow, trails), so each run differs and the seed reproduces it. off: the defaults.

options.label: Races
options.description: Which races may fight (at least two): the needle (spread shot, blink), the armour block (plasma, shield), the ring (homing darts, mines), the insect (chain lightning, drones), the crescent (boomerang, cloak), the ram (flak, tractor) and the lance (piercing lance, repulse).

options.label: Matchups
options.description: mix: mostly duels, sometimes two against two or three-way. duel, teams or ffa: only that kind (three-way needs three races).

options.label: Time limit
options.description: Seconds a battle may last; then the side with the most hull left wins.

options.label: Planet gravity
options.description: Planet mass, as a multiple of the default; 0 turns the pull off.

options.label: Planet size
options.description: Planet radius, as a multiple of the default.

options.label: Closing boundary
options.description: How fast the arena closes after 12 s without a hit, as a multiple of the default; 0 never closes it.

options.label: Palette
options.description: race: each race in its own colour. ember, ice, phosphor: every race drawn from one colour family.

options.label: Glow
options.description: Strength of the glow around every line; the lines themselves stay sharp.

options.label: Engine trails
options.description: Strength of the trail each ship leaves.

options.label: Quality
options.description: auto: fewer particles and a smaller glow buffer on weak GPUs. Hull edges are always drawn at full resolution.

options.label: Camera
options.description: auto: follows the fight, zooming in as the ships close and out as they part, with a punch-in on each kill. fixed: the whole arena, no zoom.

options.label: Closest zoom
options.description: How close the auto camera may get, as the largest share of the screen height one ship may fill.

options.label: Random seed
options.description: Fixes the matchups and every battle so a run can be reproduced; 0 = random.
